entries.content_plain:
Introduction

 The number and offices of the singers and players on musical instruments; and their division by lot into twenty-four courses, vv. 1-31. 

 Verse 1 

 David and the captains of the host - The chiefs of those who formed the several orders: not military captains. 

 Should prophesy - Should accompany their musical instruments with prayer and singing.

entries.content_osis: <hi type="bold">Verse 2</hi> <div eID="gen13801" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen13802" type="x-p"/> Which prophesied - Sung hymns and prayed. But the Targum understands this of prophesying in the proper sense of the term; and therefore says, "Who prophesied by the Holy Spirit." Jarchi is of the same opinion and quotes the case of Elisha, <reference osisRef="2Kgs.3.15">2Kgs 3:15</reference>; While the minstrel played, the hand of the Lord [i.e., the spirit of prophecy] was upon him.
